# Univerbal

> > Univerbal is an AI-powered language tutor offering real conversation practice across 22+ languages with personalized learning scenarios.

Built as Swiss Made Software, Univerbal leverages AI models from Meta, Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI to provide speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and conversational AI for language learners. The platform serves both individual learners and educational institutions through Univerbal for Business.

## Key Topics

- AI Language Tutor
- Conversation Practice
- Personalized Learning
- Swiss Made Software
- Univerbal for Business
- 22+ Supported Languages
- Speech Recognition (STT/TTS)
- LLM-powered tutoring
- Meta, Google, Microsoft, OpenAI models
- SaaS Platform
- Classroom Integration
- Progress Tracking
- AI Transparency
- Ambassador Program
